run: set -eux; bkt_version=0.37.0; case "$(dpkg --print-architecture)" in amd64) bkt_sha256=ecbd3eede690b83cf353473c0c2e1da8e2ba61c007c60015cbc2f143b5a76aae ;; arm64) bkt_sha256=4ff8a8d09c1025d0b1578e773a190ad5977086eb81be1dac5a249e0c57594da5 ;; *) echo "unsupported bkt architecture: $(dpkg --print-architecture)" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac; bkt_deb="/tmp/bkt_${bkt_version}_$(dpkg --print-architecture).deb"; curl -fsSL "https://github.com/avivsinai/bitbucket-cli/releases/download/v${bkt_version}/bkt_${bkt_version}_$(dpkg --print-architecture).deb" -o "$bkt_deb"; echo "$bkt_sha256  $bkt_deb" | sha256sum -c; dpkg -i "$bkt_deb"; rm -f "$bkt_deb"; bkt --version | grep -F "$bkt_version"
